in_english.name: Anaza
in_english.meaning: A feminine given name indicating elevation and high status
in_english.long_meaning: Anaza is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 'أنز' (ʾ-n-z), which signifies elevation, high status, or loftiness. The name may be linked to Quranic interpretations emphasizing exaltation and nobility. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a woman of high rank or spiritual significance. The name carries connotations of dignity, honor, and elevated social standing.
